summary: Youxin Technology Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting that on April 21, 2026 it entered into a definitive share acquisition agreement to acquire 18% of YATOP Group Limited for $10.8 million, to be paid via a share exchange, implying a YATOP equity value of ~$60.8 million based on a third-party valuation. No board recommendation or advisor named. The transaction, expected to close around May 2026, is a minority stake purchase by Youxin (Nasdaq: YAAS) to expand into TikTok ecosystem services. Watch for closing conditions and shareholder approval; risk-arb angle is minimal due to small stake and share-exchange consideration.
